messages.text: Can I upgrade the slim fan on the thor p2 ?
Read the hammer miner thor p2 page
Handed to the team · fan compatibility not in product data

There's no fan upgrade option on the P2, it ships as one unit: 2x BM1373, fan plus heatsink, about 166 W and roughly 40 dB. That's already quiet for a 10 TH/s box.

Whether the stock fan can be swapped for a thicker one, I won't guess at the size and connector. I've asked our hardware guy to confirm, and note that opening it up or overclocking it isn't covered by warranty. The team is offline until 10am ET today and will come back to you by email.

Anything else about the P2 I can answer now?
Before you go, one thing: what's holding you back from ordering the P2?
I already ordered one and it shipped
Good, that explains the fan question then. Before I let you go: what's making you want a different fan on it, noise or heat where it'll be running?
I know computer parts and thicker fans are more efficient. Was thinking a noctua fans and pushes more air

Makes sense, a thicker Noctua moves more air at lower RPM. Fair warning though, opening the case to swap it puts the unit outside warranty, so it's worth waiting for what JD confirms about the mount and connector before you cut anything.

Last thing and I'll leave you alone: is the better fan so you can push the P2 harder, or just to keep it cooler and quieter as it is?

Got it, thanks for telling me. That's useful for us to know.

Enjoy the P2 when it lands, and the fan answer comes back to you by email once the team is in at 10am ET.

Understood, stock clocks it is. That keeps you well inside the warranty either way.

You're all set, and the fan answer will reach you by email.
Anytime. A copy of this chat comes to your email once we close it here, so you'll have the fan notes in writing too. Happy mining.
